description: 1. Agent uses `find . -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -delete` (or equivalent) to remove the 3 stale log files (ep01_transcode_2024.log, ep02_transcode_2024.log, ep01_render_batch_jan.log) while leaving the 3 recent ones intact. 2. Agent uses `find . -name '*.tmp' -delete` to remove all 9 .tmp files, then `find . -type d -empty -delete` to remove 3 empty directories. 3. Agent uses `grep -rl 'Status: REVISION' .` to find files containing the revision flag, creates a `quarantine/` directory, and uses `mv` or `find -exec mv` to relocate those files there. 4. Agent uses `find . -type f -name '*.*' | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort | uniq -c` for extension stats, `find . -type f -exec ls -lh {} \; | sort -k5 -hr` or `find . -size +1M` to count large files (4 total), and `du -sh .` for overall size, writing all results into `audit_report.txt`.
